items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that was, I like them pictures. Joe Murray gave us this. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's my, this is Murray, you see? Yeah, uh-huh. And I believe he came down that day. See, there's the Brunus. Oh, yeah. Merritt, Georgie was down too, that's Abby. That's Georgie, yeah. And that's Merritt, yeah, that's Papa. In the yard here.
